hypothesis: Typed bar-space GEOMETRY primitive reuse across distinct TICK and CLOSE carriers for same domain and structural state may eliminate recomputation while preserving masks.
scientific_limit: No new economic data, no full shard GA1 reruns; recorded M2 shapes are used as synthetic workload shape only.

synthetic_workload.basis: V259 architecture audit NQX BUY M2 carrier t00
synthetic_workload.mode: same synthetic fixture seeded deterministically; baseline direct V221 geometry_eval per variant per candidate; factorized exact bar primitive compiler once and reuse for both carriers
synthetic_workload.measured: compute wall+CPU, output bitmap SHA equality, cold logical compute with no application primitive cache, warm cache across both carriers, artifact pack/serialization bytes, resource RSS, repeat noise
synthetic_workload.excluded: raw tick ingestion, bar/indicator feature creation, complete candidate generation, aliases, global reduction, statistics and execution simulation

precommitted_decision.accept_minimal_technical_feasibility: 0 exact output mismatches across all 79 variants plus prior 288 independent event-generator cases and exact 3 original config-stream roots
precommitted_decision.continue_to_real_regression: cold and shared-carrier combined synthetic wall >=2.0x faster in median, no physical event mask loss, feasible bounded RAM, no output hash changes
precommitted_decision.production_promotion: NOT_ALLOWED by EX001 regardless of result; full real M12/M15/M2 exact root/count regression; independent stratified direct generator and real XAU/SELL; future/corruption/crash; >=2.0x median full-pipeline improvement on representative frozen inputs and peak RSS <=1.25x baseline or documented complexity-risk exception; immutable authoritative governance transition required
precommitted_decision.falsify: Any mask mismatch, stale-key reuse, irrecoverable IR, unstable checkpoint or no feasible net end-to-end benefit stops this branch or limits it to measured domains.
